title: The generic ambient stalk of a regular integral Cartier divisor is a DVR
statement: Let j:D -> X be an effective Cartier centre [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], with D integral and eta a generic point of D. If O_{X,j(eta)} is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme], then it is a domain and, equipped with this domain property, is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring].

source.place: Tags 0EYG (generic divisor local calculation), 00NP (regular local domains), 00PD (principal nonzero maximal ideal criterion).

proof.text: Install integrality of D and regularity of the ambient stalk. The uniqueness of the generic point identifies eta with genericPoint D, so its stalk is the function field and is a field. The ambient regular local stalk is a domain by IsRegularLocalRing.isDomain.

The Cartier centre is a closed immersion; its surjective stalk map to the field has kernel equal to the maximal ideal (IsLocalRing.ker_eq_maximalIdeal). Choose the Cartier affine neighbourhood U. By Scheme.Hom.ker_stalkMap the stalk-map kernel is the image of the Cartier ideal under the germ map. The affine germ map is a localization and hence flat; Ideal.IsRegularPrincipal.map_of_flat transports the nonzerodivisor generator to the stalk. This writes its maximal ideal as span(t) with t in the nonzerodivisors.

The stalk is nontrivial since it is local, so the nonzerodivisor generator is nonzero. Apply IsDiscreteValuationRing.of_maximalIdeal_eq_span_singleton to the Noetherian local domain and this principal maximal ideal. This supplies the DVR proof for the same stalk and the domain proof already established.

lean.statement:
theorem regular_cartier_generic_stalk_dvr
    {X D : Scheme.{u}} (j : D ⟶ X) (hD : IsIntegral D)
    (hj : IsEffectiveCartierCenter j) (η : D) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (j η))) :
    ∃ hdom : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (j η)),
      letI := hdom
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk (j η))
